description: Effective values fitted to the 2024 Italian GP (Monza) only; 2025 is held out for evaluation

method.pit_loss: median of 14 measured 2024 stops (in-lap + out-lap - 2 x clean pace)
method.tyre_grip: bisection on [1.0, 5.0] to 0.0001: zero mean error of the 4 model cars' flying laps against each team's best 2024 qualifying lap
